verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise him, you servants of the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD.
Let the name of the LORD be praised, now and forever.
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD should be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations. His glory is above the skies.
Who is like the LORD our God, who sits on his throne on high,
who bends down to look at the heavens and the earth?
He lifts the poor out of the dust. He raises the needy from the rubbish heap.
He seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.
He gives the woman who has no children a home and makes her a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD!
